issues.problem: The counters show no 'upgrades_bought' (and no 'dropper_bought' or 'conveyor_bought'), although 'pad_highlighted' is 1, so the Dropper 2 pad became affordable. The purchase flow (deduct 10 once, pad vanishes, next pads appear) never ran, so those acceptance criteria are unverified. Also, 15 cubes dropped in a 32.5s run where 'auto_claims' is 1 (claim at roughly 20s) is more than a 2s cadence would give, so the drop timing is suspicious.
issues.fix_hint: Make sure a successful purchase calls ForgeTelemetry.bump('upgrades_bought') exactly once, after the cost is deducted. Make the ForgeTest/probe walk the character onto the Dropper 2 pad once Cash >= 10 so the counter is exercised. Check that the dropper loop starts only after the plot is claimed and uses a 2s interval, so cubes_dropped matches the spec.

issues.problem: The playtest never bought anything (no upgrades_bought or dropper_bought). The Dropper 2 pad is likely off the player's route after the claim teleport, so the main reward moment is never reached.
issues.fix_hint: After a claim, teleport the player to a spot facing the conveyor and within about 12 studs of the Dropper 2 pad. Keep the pad off the direct spawn line so it is not triggered by accident. Give it a Neon accent glow and a PointLight so it is the brightest thing nearby.

issues.problem: CLAIM_TIMEOUT = 20 means a new player waits up to 20s in the plaza with nothing earning. The design doc wants the claim at about 3s and the first cash at about 8s.
issues.fix_hint: Set CLAIM_TIMEOUT to 5. Add a countdown line to the gate BillboardGui, such as 'Claim Candy Plot - auto in 3...', so a 10-year-old sees what is about to happen.

issues.problem: Census beams=0 and tutorial_reshown=1: the guidance beam or arrow was not visible and the step stalled. Nothing visibly guides the player to the $10 pad.
issues.fix_hint: Lower STUCK_RESHOW_SECONDS from 5 to 3. Keep the BEAM_COLOR beam attached to the current target (the Dropper 2 pad first) for the whole step. Add a bobbing arrow above the pad that stays until upgrades_bought >= 1.

issues.problem: Cash-in feedback is the same for every cube, and only 2 milestones fired in 13 collects. Nothing escalates, so the loop flattens after the first few cubes.
issues.fix_hint: Fire a bigger effect every 10th cube: a gold sparkle burst at the collector plus a rising-pitch tick using milestonePitchForTier. Make the floating +$N bigger and gold on milestones, and flash the collector Neon yellow for 0.1s on every collect.

issues.problem: The playtest shows no purchase progression, and the first 60 seconds should chain buys. The price curve after Dropper 2 (10) and Speed 1 (22) may leave long dead gaps with nothing to chase.
issues.fix_hint: Keep the first four purchases at $10, $22, about $40 and about $75, so one purchase lands roughly every 10-15s. Make sure each upgrade has a distinct visible effect (a new dropper model, an ore colour change with sparkles=true) so every buy changes the look of the plot.

issues.problem: The rebirth cost (baseCost 5000) is lower than the design doc's roughly $25k, and with costGrowth 2 the long-term chase is short. After the 10 upgrades there is little to chase.
issues.fix_hint: Raise baseCost to 20000, keep costGrowth at 2 and multPerRebirth at 0.5. Show 'Rebirth at $20K' on the HUD goal bar so players have a visible end target.

summary: The game starts cleanly with no errors or warnings. The plaza, 6 themed plots, plot claim (via auto-claim), dropping, collecting and cash-in feedback all happened: map_built, plaza_built, themes_built=6, plot_assigned, cubes_dropped=15 and cubes_collected=13. The purchase path was never exercised in the playtest, so upgrades_bought is missing. Several acceptance criteria therefore remain unverified.

fun.summary: The setup is strong: 6 themed plots, 0 grey parts, 4 lighting effects, 6 ScreenGuis and a working drop-to-collect-to-cash loop (15 cubes dropped, 13 collected, cash-in FX and sounds firing). The evidence never shows the core spend moment, though: no upgrades_bought, shop_opened or shop_purchases counters appeared, so the loop of earning then buying then seeing growth is unproven. The biggest improvement is to make the first buy (Dropper 2 for $10) impossible to miss and quick to reach, and to cut the idle wait before the plot claim.
missing_juice: upgrade purchased: pad pop, rise tween, sparkle burst and camera shake (no upgrades_bought, so none seen)
shop opened and shop purchase: Whoosh, Back-tween panel, level bar fill (shop_opened never counted)
ore tier upgrade: shockwave ring, FOV punch and RewardPopup (never reached)
not enough cash: Error buzz and pad flash (no evidence)
census shows beams=0, so the tutorial beam or arrow is not visible during play
